hunks.summary: The blank quoted line that closes the generated Status paragraph; formatting only.

A pointer: obtaining a payload from a signed release, and what a consumer establishes before packaging it, is runtime-mobile/v2, which imposes nothing on a v1 consumer. It changes no v1 obligation. The audit drops the pointer's earlier description of v2 as a design target, stale since v2 shipped in v2.5.0-rc.10. The pointer stays where the telemetry reference is restored because it adds no obligation, and runtime-mobile/v2 states the same fact itself; the audit's wording correction is 87bd0c9.

The runtime-telemetry/v1 reference gained a statement that runtime-telemetry/v2 supersedes it and a list of what telemetry v2 additionally requires of the payload. It links a document this version froze without. runtime-telemetry/v2 states those requirements itself, so v1's frozen line is restored and no requirement is lost.
